# scSimEvalStudio: Interactive Shiny Studio for Single-Cell Multiomics Simulation Benchmarking

`scSimEvalStudio` (version `0.99.3`) is the interactive graphical benchmarking studio companion to [`scSimEval`](https://kabilanbio.github.io/scSimEval/) (version `0.99.12`). It operationalizes reference-based simulation benchmarking by comparing one or more synthetic datasets against an empirical biological reference dataset across **56 curated quantitative evaluation measures** organized into **8 canonical biological and computational categories** on Bioconductor **`SingleCellExperiment`** S4 objects (`scRNA-seq` [44 measures], `scATAC-seq` [38 measures], `Paired Co-Assay Multiomics` [56 measures], and `Unpaired Multiomics` [56 measures]).
